messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a pin conflict for tonight's 02:00 UTC window. Deploybot selected runtime v2.1.0 but console is pinned to v2.0.3. We need to decide: proceed, rollback runtime, or change pin on console. Anyone able to weigh in?
deploy-bot: automated: Scheduled deploy queued for 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC. Components: api=stable, runtime=v2.1.0, console=v2.0.3. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Rollback command: /deploy rollback runtime v2.0.3.
jon: I can be on-call for the window. Quick q: what changed in v2.1.0 that breaks console?
kevin: v2.1.0 introduces header-splitting and a small auth handshake change — console expects the old header format. In staging the console logged 400s when header wasn't present.
sre-ops: recommend conservative path: either rollback runtime to v2.0.3 or gate the new header behind a flag so console continues to see legacy headers. Rollforward with mismatch risks 500s for ~2% of traffic (based on staging).
maria: Can we feature-flag the header in runtime for the canary only? That would let console proceed unchanged while we validate runtime.
orchestrator: We have a routing rule toggle we can apply per-canary. Option: route 5% to runtime-v2.1.0 with header-flag disabled, then enable header for subsequent waves if no errors.
kevin: That sounds good. But console is pinned in config to v2.0.3 via pinset 'console-stable'. Changing pin requires approvals from product/pm. How fast can we change pin?
jon: If we change pin we should document in release notes and product will want a rollback plan. Are we ok with doing a pin update pre-window?
maria: I'd prefer not to change pins without PM signoff. So let's do the canary-with-flag approach. Can deploy-bot create a canary rollout with header-flag off and a manual kill-switch if error spike >1% 5xxs?
deploy-bot: acknowledged. Updated deploy plan: runtime=v2.1.0 canary 5% with feature-flag 'new-header'=off. Kill-switch: manual hold, auto-abort if 1% 5xx increase sustained for 3 mins.
sre-ops: I'll also add a temporary router rule to prefer runtime-legacy for auth endpoints unless header 'x-rwd-new' present. Pushing the rule now; will roll before 01:45 UTC.
kevin: Please also add a small metric in console that flags header parse errors so we can get early signal.
jon: I'll update release notes: "runtime v2.1.0 introduces header-splitting behind feature-flag. Console pinned to v2.0.3; canary will run with flag disabled. Rollback: /deploy rollback runtime v2.0.3."
maria: Thanks. Let's meet 30m before window in #eng-releases to confirm readiness. If PM wants to unpin console later, we'll require a follow-up release.
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: preflight check at 01:30 UTC. Preflight checklist: routing rule present, canary flag configured, kill-switch set, release notes updated.
kevin: :thumbsup: I'll watch the logs during canary.
sre-ops: Router rule applied and verified in staging. Will push to prod by 01:40 UTC.
maria: Perfect. Tagging @product for awareness (notifying asynchronously). If anything changes, update this thread. :eyes:
